name: sim_geometry_thurston_geometrization_constraint_canonical
description: Thurston Geometrization: 3-manifold decomposition into 8 geometric types (unique per piece)

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/algebraic computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG message passing not needed; constraint geometry handled via SMT solver

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs in this sim

cvc5.reason: cvc5 SMT solver: load_bearing proof of geometry type constraints

sympy.reason: sympy: supportive symbolic algebra for Euler characteristic and topology

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; 3-manifold topology constraints only

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; constraints handled via SMT solver

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; no graph structure in this sim

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; pairwise interactions only

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard algebraic ops sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology in this sim

positive_euler_characteristic_sum.reason: Euler characteristic is additive under decomposition

negative_multiple_geometries_same_piece.reason: Cannot assign two distinct geometries to same piece (UNSAT)

negative_no_geometry_assigned.reason: Every piece must have at least one geometry (UNSAT)

negative_all_geometries_assigned.reason: Cannot assign all 8 geometries to single piece (UNSAT)

boundary_lens_space_geometries.reason: Lens space geometry depends on topological parameter p

special_geometries.Nil: non-abelian geometry, admits certain Seifert fibrations
special_geometries.Sol: solvable geometry, admits torus bundles over circles

boundary_rare_geometries.reason: Nil and Sol geometries exist but are geometrically rare

boundary_h3_pi1_rank.reason: H³ geometry allows arbitrary fundamental group rank (SAT)
